content.text:
h14.

**Computation site:** `RebuildMemoPayload()` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll()` implemented in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-422`. `ExtractAll` parses the memo's raw Markdown content into a goldmark AST and does a single walk to build a `MemoPayload_Property` struct plus tag/mention lists, which `RebuildMemoPayload` then assigns to `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:85-86` in runner.go).

**Triggers:**
- On memo creation — `CreateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` calls `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` before `s.Store.CreateMemo`.
- On memo update, but only when the update mask includes the `content` field path — `UpdateMemo` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:435-451` recomputes the payload only inside the `case path == "content"` branch (edits to visibility, pinned, tags, etc. alone don't retrigger it).
- Batch/backfill path — `Runner.RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72`) pages through all memos and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for each; this exists as reusable maintenance/migration logic but is not currently wired into `server/server.go`'s startup/cron registrations (unlike e.g. the s3presign runner), so today it's only exercised via tests/manual invocation.

**Extracted properties** (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:21-25, 383-408`):
- `Tags` — all `#tag` nodes found in the content (deduplicated, case preserved).
- `Mentions` — `@username` mentions (lower-cased, deduped) — collected in the same pass but not persisted onto `Payload` by `RebuildMemoPayload` (only `Tags`/`Property` are).
- `Property.Title` — text of the first block-level node if it's an H1 heading.
- `Property.HasLink` — set if any Markdown link node is present.
- `Property.HasCode` — set if any code block, fenced code block, or code span is present.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — set if any task checkbox is present.
- `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` — set if any task checkbox is unchecked.

## Summary

This is the **usememos/memos** repo (Go backend + React frontend). The memo model's derived (non-user-set) metadata is computed by a dedicated markdown-extraction service and stored in the memo's `Payload` proto, plus a snippet computed on-the-fly for API responses.

### 1. Where derived metadata is computed

**`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`** — the core extraction logic, using goldmark to parse the memo's markdown content:

- `ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)` (line 356) — single-pass extraction of everything below; returns `ExtractedData{Tags, Mentions, Property}`.
- `ExtractTags` (line 143) — walks the AST collecting `#tag` nodes.
- `ExtractProperties` (line 193) — computes boolean properties.
- `GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)` (line 264) — builds a plain-text preview/snippet by walking the AST, skipping code blocks, joining block text with spaces, and truncating at a word boundary (`truncateAtWord`, line 472) with `...` suffix.
- `extractHeadingText` (line 173) — pulls plain text out of the first H1 heading node to use as a derived "title".

**`/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`** — the glue that takes extraction output and writes it onto the memo:

```go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	if memo.Payload == nil {
		memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
	}
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```
(lines 74-88)

**`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-89`** — `getMemoContentSnippet(content string)` wraps `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)` (fixed 64-char snippet length) for use in API/webhook/notification responses.

### 2. What triggers the recomputation

- **On memo create**: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` — inside `CreateMemo`, right after content-length validation, calls `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` before persisting.
- **On memo update (only if content changed)**: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:436-451` — inside `UpdateMemo`'s field-mask loop, when `path == "content"`, it sets `memo.Content = request.Memo.Content` then calls `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo, s.MarkdownService)` again (payload is *not* touched if content isn't part of the update mask).
- **Snippet for API responses** (not persisted, computed per-request): `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80` in `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` — calls `s.getMemoContentSnippet(memo.Content)` and sets `memoMessage.Snippet`. Also called in batch form for related memos (`memo_service_converter.go:225,248`), for memo relations (`memo_relation_service.go:154,162`), and for notification payloads in `user_service_notifications.go:318-391` (`memoNotificationSnippet`) used by comment/mention inbox notifications.
- **Mention extraction (side-channel of the same `ExtractAll`)**: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32` — `resolveMentionTargets` calls `ExtractAll` again on both new and previous content to diff `@mentions` and dispatch inbox notifications.
- **Bulk/background rebuild**: `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72` — `Runner.RunOnce` batches through `Store.ListMemos` (100 at a time) and calls `RebuildMemoPayload` + `Store.UpdateMemo` for every memo, i.e., a maintenance/backfill job. Note: unlike the sibling `s3presign` runner (which is wired into `server/server.go:163` as a periodic job), this `memopayload` runner is **not currently invoked anywhere** in the codebase outside its own package/tests — it appears to exist as an on-demand backfill utility (e.g., for reprocessing when extraction logic changes) rather than a scheduled job.

### 3. Specific fields extracted/derived

From `storepb.MemoPayload` / `storepb.MemoPayload_Property` (proto: `/bench/repo/proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:265-278`, generated: `/bench/repo/proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go`):

- `Payload.Tags []string` — all `#tag` occurrences in content (deduped, case preserved) — via `ExtractTags`/`ExtractAll`.
- `Payload.Property.Title string` — derived from the **first H1 heading** if it's the first block in the document (`extractHeadingText`, markdown.go:173-179); proto comment: "The title extracted from the first H1 heading, if present."
- `Payload.Property.HasLink bool` — true if any markdown link node exists.

## Summary

This is the **usememos/memos** repo (Go backend + React frontend). The memo model's derived (non-user-set) metadata is computed by a dedicated markdown-extraction service and stored in the memo's `Payload` proto, plus a snippet computed on-the-fly for API responses.

### 1. Where derived metadata is computed

**`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go`** — the core extraction logic, using goldmark to parse the memo's markdown content:

- `ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)` (line 356) — single-pass extraction of everything below; returns `ExtractedData{Tags, Mentions, Property}`.
- `ExtractTags` (line 143) — walks the AST collecting `#tag` nodes.
- `ExtractProperties` (line 193) — computes boolean properties.
- `GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)` (line 264) — builds a plain-text preview/snippet by walking the AST, skipping code blocks, joining block text with spaces, and truncating at a word boundary (`truncateAtWord`, line 472) with `...` suffix.
- `extractHeadingText` (line 173) — pulls plain text out of the first H1 heading node to use as a derived "title".

**`/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`** — the glue that takes extraction output and writes it onto the memo:

```go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	if memo.Payload == nil {
		memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
	}
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property
	return nil
}
```

**`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-89`** — `getMemoContentSnippet(content string)` wraps `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet([]byte(content), 64)` (fixed 64-char snippet length) for use in API/webhook/notification responses.

### 2. What triggers the recomputation

- **On memo create**: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` — inside `CreateMemo`, right after content-length validation, calls `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, create, s.MarkdownService)` before persisting.
